blocks.text: Al-Jameel The Beautiful is a Name that is established in the sunnah of the Prophet ﷺ. Muslim reports it in his saheeh from 'Abdullaah bin Mas'ood that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"He who has in his heart the weight of a mustard seed of pride shall not enter Paradise. A man said: Verily a person loves to have nice clothes and shoes. He ﷺ remarked: Verily, Allah is Beautiful and loves beauty. Pride is disdaining the truth (out of self-conceit) and contempt for the people."
This noble Name indicates the establishment of beauty for Allaah in His Names, Attributes, His Self and His Actions. Ibnul Qayyim said,

"His beauty is of four levels: beauty of Self, beauty of Attributes, beauty of Actions and beauty of Names. All of His Names are beautiful and perfect, all His Attributes are perfect, all of His Actions are from wisdom, are of benefit and are just and merciful. As for the beauty of Self and what it means, then it is an issue that no one perceives other than Him. No one apart from Him knows. The creation only knows what has been explained to the noblest of His servants. For indeed this beauty is protected from others, veiled with the raiment of the cloak and waist wrapper as His Messenger ﷺ said in what is related from him, "Magnificence is my cloak and greatness is my lower garment." So what do you think about beauty that is guarded by attributes of perfection and veiled with descriptions of greatness and majesty? From this meaning some of the meanings of beauty of His Self is understood. A servant advances in knowing the Actions to knowing the Attributes and from knowing the Attributes to knowing the Self. If he witnesses something of the beauty of the Actions he takes it as a proof of the beauty of the Attributes then he takes the beauty of the Attributes as a proof of the beauty of His Self..."
blocks.ref: Ibn Al-Qayyim, Al-Fawaa'id p. 322 (the hadeeth within it: Musnad Ahmad 2/376, narrated by Aboo Hurayrah)

blocks.text: This and the completion of blessings upon the people of paradise is the greatest blessing of them seeing their God, their Lord and beautiful Majestic Protector.

Indeed it is the greatest of what they are given, the noblest of what they obtain, the apple of their eyes, the delight of the souls, the pleasure of their hearts, the light on their faces and the greatest honour. In Saheeh Muslim Suhayb narrated from the Prophet ﷺ that he said,

"When those deserving Paradise enter Paradise, the Blessed and the Exalted will ask: 'Do you wish Me to give you anything more?' They will say: 'Have You not brightened our faces? Have You not made us enter Paradise and saved us from the Fire?' He (the narrator) said: He (God) will lift the veil, and of things given to them nothing would be dearer to them than the sight of their Lord, the Mighty and the Glorious."
O Allaah! We ask You for the delight of seeing Your Noble Face, we yearn to meet You without harm or trials that lead one astray.

keyPoints: Al-Jameel is established in the sunnah in the hadeeth of 'Abdullaah bin Mas'ood: "Verily, Allah is Beautiful and loves beauty."
The Name indicates the establishment of beauty for Allaah in His Names, Attributes, His Self and His Actions.
Ibnul Qayyim said His beauty is of four levels: beauty of Self, of Attributes, of Actions and of Names; the beauty of His Self is something no one perceives other than Him.
A servant advances from knowing the beauty of the Actions to the Attributes, and from the Attributes to the Self, taking each as proof of the next.
The greatest blessing for the people of Paradise is seeing their Lord, as in the hadeeth of Suhayb in Saheeh Muslim.

evidence.text: "Verily, Allah is Beautiful and loves beauty. Pride is disdaining the truth (out of self-conceit) and contempt for the people."
"...He will lift the veil, and of things given to them nothing would be dearer to them than the sight of their Lord, the Mighty and the Glorious."

recall.q: What does Al-Jameel mean and what does it indicate?
recall.a: The Beautiful; it indicates the establishment of beauty for Allaah in His Names, Attributes, His Self and His Actions.

recall.q: Which hadeeth establishes the Name Al-Jameel?
recall.a: The hadeeth of 'Abdullaah bin Mas'ood in Saheeh Muslim: "Verily, Allah is Beautiful and loves beauty..."

recall.q: What are the four levels of Allaah's beauty according to Ibnul Qayyim?
recall.a: Beauty of Self, beauty of Attributes, beauty of Actions and beauty of Names.

recall.q: What is the greatest blessing given to the people of Paradise?
recall.a: Seeing their Lord; nothing given to them would be dearer to them than the sight of their Lord (hadeeth of Suhayb, Saheeh Muslim).
